summary: The integrated packet is safe as an assessment and proposed implementation plan. It separates local, remote, live and CI evidence; does not claim compromise or security certification; and does not authorize account changes or public dispatch. Correct one wrong canonical shell path before handing the plan to workers. Two wording clarifications improve publication and ADR consistency.

claim_evidence.claim: Production edge assurance is partial, despite a successful deployment.
evidence: assets/audit/comprehensive-2026-09-05/ci-live-edge/live-edge-report.json: status PARTIAL; checks 427, failures 0, blocked 38, warnings 315
assets/audit/comprehensive-2026-09-05/live-security-headers.json: sampled GitHub responses omit desired response headers
claim_evidence.assessment: Accurately qualified; page meta CSP is acknowledged. No false no-CSP or active-compromise claim.

claim_evidence.claim: Package verification accepts a changed copied JavaScript file.
evidence: scripts/build-release.py:167-179 hashes sitemap and English index only
scripts/build-release.py:222-230 verifies only those hashes plus inventory
assets/audit/comprehensive-2026-09-05/release-integrity-probe.json
claim_evidence.assessment: Negative fixture supports the narrow custom-verifier gap. Packet does not claim an observed supply-chain attack.

claim_evidence.claim: Replit root publication has a different boundary from Pages, but live Replit exposure is not established.
evidence: .replit:67-69 publicDir dot
scripts/build-release.py explicit allowlist
assessment limits state authenticated Replit deployment was not inspected
claim_evidence.assessment: Conditional priority and explicit absence of exposure claim are appropriate.

claim_evidence.claim: Delegation briefs are proposals rather than dispatched or blanket-authorized account work.
evidence: Brief A prohibits unapproved push, merge, account settings, sibling propagation and publishing
Brief E prohibits applying design variants to public artifact
Brief F prohibits DNS, hosting, preload, credentials and production changes
Brief G separates review from publication
claim_evidence.assessment: Scope and publication authority are sufficiently explicit; Copilot reviewable PR output belongs to a future authorized implementation task.

claim_evidence.claim: Sibling foundation compatibility must be preserved and propagated through controlled integration.
evidence: docs/adr/0001-shared-runtime-compatibility.md: shared three-file byte-identical superset
scripts/sync-foundation-files.py: explicit source/revision and lock handling
claim_evidence.assessment: One integrator, compatibility testing and authorized propagation avoid accidental fleet edits.

claim_evidence.claim: Analytics changes require a fresh owner decision rather than silently reversing a prior decision.
evidence: docs/sxs-infrastructure-audit-2026-08-29.md:138-144 records owner decision to remove visible consent UI
plan W13 explicitly revisits an existing owner policy
claim_evidence.assessment: Appropriate preference continuity; packet avoids legal noncompliance conclusions.

assets/partials/head.html

material_objections.blocking_scope: Worker dispatch involving the shell; not delivery of the assessment as a draft
material_objections.objection: Concurrency ownership names nonexistent site-src/partials/** instead of the renderer actual assets/partials/**. A worker may create a duplicate source tree or edit the wrong surface.
material_objections.smallest_change: Replace only that path with assets/partials/** and rehash the judged packet.

nonblocking_notes.note: Only French is described as published/indexable, while all 20 locale routes are publicly served. Adjacent wording explains draft addressability, but published is overloaded.
nonblocking_notes.suggestion: Say only French is approved for indexing; all 20 locale routes are publicly addressable.

nonblocking_notes.note: The existing ADR explicitly says keep wide-screen lerp follow, while CSS sticky is a proposed replacement in the workstream. Reduced-motion correction is compatible; changing default behavior may revise that decision.
nonblocking_notes.suggestion: When implementing W07, preserve the accepted default behavior or amend the relevant ADR decision in the same review, with sibling compatibility evidence.

smallest_decisive_tests: Verify the plan shell path equals scripts/build-site.py PARTIALS; confirm all named existing ownership paths exist.
After any correction, recompute both packet SHA-256 values and retain this review against its original frozen hashes.
For future implementation, use the named copied-artifact tamper fixtures and attempt-specific artifact selection test; do not run a production mutation just to prove the audit.
For future host changes, validate the selected adapter with staging response headers; preserve DNS/account approval boundaries.
limitations: Reviewer is a sub-agent of the same model family and shares conversation/history with the parent; this is role-separated analysis, not independent organizational assurance.

Reviewer contributed the earlier security/delivery workstream. This review judged only the parent-authored integrated assessment and advancement plan; that contribution reduces independence for overlapping security claims.
No extra full suites, exploit tests, live account changes, external messages or publication were performed.
UI, linguistic quality, legal interpretation, field performance and external app completeness were not independently re-tested in this bounded safety/portability review.
No judged file was edited. The frozen hashes match review-input draft-1.
